name: ch9_selected_pcc27_gqceil
title: ch9_selected_pcc27 with the STS interface weight g_q raised per area for DSO_1-3 to their contraction ceilings
description: Identical to ch9_selected_pcc27 (g_w_pcc = 27 x g_w_der, shunt_int_g_w 0.06)
plus a per-area interface-Q weight for DSO_1, DSO_2 and DSO_3; DSO_4 keeps
the global g_q = 0.4977.
Why: pricing the interface setpoints lower (pcc27) makes the TSO call on
the STS more and raised e_q by 19 %. g_q / g_w_dso_der sets how fast an STS
follows its interface setpoint. A global raise is capped at ~x1.22 by
DSO_4 (binding STS row, W6); per area, DSO_1-3 can go to their own
select ceilings.
Per-area values = largest multiplier with the area's worst STS
lambda_max(B) <= the select ceiling 1.546 (bisection, method of
ch_8_D1_settling_screen.analytic; TS rows verified independent of g_q):
DSO_1 x1.556, DSO_2 x1.448, DSO_3 x1.617. Overall worst lambda_max(B)
1.546, i.e. DSO_1-3 sit at the select ceiling (author decision 2026-10-16,
chosen over the x1.25 variant that kept the certificate at 1.357).
Sweep (results/THESIS_pcc_ratio_sweep_20261015, candidate 'pcc27_gqceil'),
ranked windows W1-W4, W6, 12 h, DSO_3 x2: e_v(TS) 0.00129 (as pcc27,
-4.4 % vs ch9_selected_shunt_gw006), e_v(DS) 0.00540 (+2.7 % vs pcc27,
+13 % vs gw006), e_q 112 964 (-16 % vs pcc27, equal to gw006), recruited
flow 15.8 Mvar per STS median, no corridor violations, DSO taps worst 6 /d.
NOT part of the Chapter-9 parameter space, which carries one global g_q.
